title: Delivery & Pickup Services Tariff: Delivery Spend Credit on a Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual Switch
content:
The delivery spend credit of a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services depends on the total value of the orders placed on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date, cancelled orders included. The credit is taken off the switch charge.

| Total value of orders placed on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date | Delivery spend credit |
|---|---|
| $600.00 or more | $1.50 |
| at least $300.00 but below $600.00 | $0.75 |
| below $300.00 | nothing |

The value of an order is the value of its items as the order record shows it. Every order placed in the 3 months counts, including an order later cancelled.

## Hypothetical totals

| Orders placed in the 3 months | Total | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| $180.00, $95.50 | $275.50 | nothing |
| $180.00, $95.50, $24.50 | $300.00 | $0.75 |
| $250.00, $210.00, $139.99 (later cancelled) | $599.99 | $0.75 |
| $250.00, $210.00, $140.00 (later cancelled) | $600.00 | $1.50 |
